query: Apollo PLSS backpack height dimensions metres

facts.text: The Apollo PLSS backpack was 26 inches high, which is 66 cm or 0.66 metres.
facts.quote: The PLSS was 26 inches (66 cm) high, 18 inches (46 cm) wide, and 10 inches (25 cm) deep.
